text_block_list.text:
On one of our days off, Симболи Рудольф
and I go
out in search of some skin
cream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No such luck... I should have expected
as much.
This brand only ships by direct
order.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Usually I track how much I have left and
order
more before I run out...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But Teio insisted on trying some, and it
seems I
gave her more than I intended.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She seemed so delighted with one
bottle, I
couldn't resist giving her more...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And now I am breaking out. The price of
my own
negligence, I suppose.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It seems as if Симболи Рудольф is having
skincare
troubles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
